pages.title: Jupiter moons
pages.text:
Jupiter's four largest moons
The four Galilean moons, ordered by diameter:
Moon | Diameter (km) | Orbital period (days)
Ganymede | 5,262 | 7.2
Callisto | 4,821 | 16.7
Io | 3,643 | 1.8
Europa | 3,122 | 3.6
Values are rounded as published in NASA's fact sheet. Orbital period is the time to complete one orbit around Jupiter.
Source: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Solar System Small Worlds Fact Sheet.
Discovery
Moon | Discoverer | Year discovered
Ganymede | Galileo Galilei | 1610
Callisto | Galileo Galilei | 1610
Io | Galileo Galilei | 1610
Europa | Galileo Galilei | 1610
NASA reports that Galileo observed Jupiter’s moons in January 1610 and identified them as orbiting Jupiter. NASA: 410 Years Ago, Galileo Discovers Jupiter’s Moons.
